bounded_interface_domain: The literal common object, actual source mechanism, receiving decision, configuration, time and responsibility boundary are identified.

The named mechanism supplies the precise evidence, competence, continuity, constraint or authority input stated in the separately reasoned direction. Co-location or an invented auxiliary system is insufficient.

The complete receiver criterion and applicable obligations remain separate from the material partial contribution. A genuine partial input need not establish the entire receiving predicate.
Unknown applicability or correspondence stays unknown; no common-object guard is inferred merely from matching vocabulary.
source_record.native_common_basis: Distribute critical knowledge sufficiently to maintain the system through absence or turnover; choose the collaboration practice by its trade-offs.
common_cost_and_alternative: Count knowledge transfer, retained evidence, review, coordination, platform operation, consumer migration, exception handling and delayed decisions over the actual lifecycle.
Retain adequate existing controls, concise records, specialist ownership with backup, finite projects with competent handover, direct services, libraries, templates and no change as alternatives.

Do not count repeated shared evidence or the same common platform capacity as independent corroboration or independent savings. Actual platform net benefit and organizational comparative effects remain conditional.
source_record.evidence_ceiling: Root literal analytical arguments from the complete selected native bodies and eight executed finite discriminators. One bounded NASA standard corroborates scoped distinctions, not universal authority requirements or causal effect sizes. No new property, field experiment, whole-synthesis completion or independent acceptance.

positive_controls.argument: Impact analysis identifies the critical interface assumptions and rationale that backups must actually understand, directing a bounded sharing effort.
Acceptance criteria and documented exceptions identify the knowledge the recipient or successor must retain to assess later deliveries or handover obligations.
The exact basis and continuing obligations identify which specialized knowledge must remain available and which decisions stay with external authority.
The challenge arrangement's actual competence and independence needs identify where separate specialist knowledge must be cultivated without collapsing author and reviewer roles.
Explicit claims, premises and defeaters reveal which reasoning and evidence expertise must remain available and where reliance on one knower is consequential.
Actual control requirements and permitted specialist alternatives identify the minimal knowledge coverage needed, avoiding indiscriminate rotation.
Explicit model semantics, authority and reconciliation evidence provide a concrete learning object and delimit what a backup must understand.
The actual operating limits, monitoring duties and escalation conditions identify which critical knowledge must be retained and which acts require a separate delegation.

member_to_premise_evidence.shared_question_or_object: An operational risk decision whose evidence interpretation or response capability depends on one person.

source.bearer: A consequential residual-risk and operational decision
source.criterion: An appropriately empowered actor accepts or rejects the stated residual risk with current evidence and a defined operating boundary.

receiver.bearer: A system whose maintainability depends on knowledge concentrated in too few people.
receiver.criterion: Distribute critical knowledge sufficiently to maintain the system through absence or turnover; choose the collaboration practice by its trade-offs.

guard: The literal common object, actual source mechanism, receiving decision, configuration, time and responsibility boundary are identified.

The named mechanism supplies the precise evidence, competence, continuity, constraint or authority input stated in the separately reasoned direction. Co-location or an invented auxiliary system is insufficient.
Competence, access, independent challenge, delegation, regulatory credit and risk acceptance remain distinct; one does not establish the others.
The complete receiver criterion and applicable obligations remain separate from the material partial contribution. A genuine partial input need not establish the entire receiving predicate.
Unknown applicability or correspondence stays unknown; no common-object guard is inferred merely from matching vocabulary.
member_to_premise_evidence.source_contribution: The actual operating limits, monitoring duties and escalation conditions identify which critical knowledge must be retained and which acts require a separate delegation.
member_to_premise_evidence.receiving_consequence: The actual operating limits, monitoring duties and escalation conditions identify which critical knowledge must be retained and which acts require a separate delegation.
premises_supplied: The actual operating limits, monitoring duties and escalation conditions identify which critical knowledge must be retained and which acts require a separate delegation.
premises_remaining: Distribute critical knowledge sufficiently to maintain the system through absence or turnover; choose the collaboration practice by its trade-offs.
The receiver-native conditions not established by the literal partial contribution, including actual net benefit and any remaining authority or evidence.
member_to_premise_evidence.counterexample: A risk grant naming an unavailable specialist does not establish resilient operational knowledge coverage.
member_to_premise_evidence.counter_control: A risk grant naming an unavailable specialist does not establish resilient operational knowledge coverage.
member_to_premise_evidence.nontrigger: The stated common object or actual receiving use is known absent; if merely unknown, no negative is inferred.
specific_cost_and_alternative: Count knowledge transfer, retained evidence, review, coordination, platform operation, consumer migration, exception handling and delayed decisions over the actual lifecycle.
Retain adequate existing controls, concise records, specialist ownership with backup, finite projects with competent handover, direct services, libraries, templates and no change as alternatives.
Authority follows the actual regime. Same-person roles or preauthorized local decisions remain possible where permitted; an actual separation requirement remains binding where applicable.

Do not count repeated shared evidence or the same common platform capacity as independent corroboration or independent savings. Actual platform net benefit and organizational comparative effects remain conditional.
member_to_premise_evidence.reentry: Reopen affected directions on changed responsibilities, delegation, expiry, issuer/basis, configuration, model correspondence, critical knowledge, platform consumers or costs, current evidence, source correction or counterexample. Known absence of this particular common use defeats the guarded instance, not every other possible material use; an unestablished guard is not a global negative.
